name: An Extended Look
subtitle: 26 minutes of gameplay · Aug 27, 2026
summary: Rockstar's first long-form gameplay showcase: about 26 minutes covering both protagonists, missions, activities and the world. It premiered on Netflix in the afternoon and hit YouTube that night.

facts.text: Premiered on Netflix at 3 p.m. ET on Thursday, August 27, 2026, then went live on Rockstar's YouTube channel and the GTA VI site at 9 p.m. ET.
Announced on August 6, 2026 with a Newswire post and a short teaser; Rockstar's statement on the gameplay leaks followed on August 26, the day before the premiere.
Netflix and Twitch reportedly buckled under demand during the premiere.
Rockstar has not called this 'Trailer 3'; as of September 2026 no third trailer has been announced.

name: Trailer 2
subtitle: May 6, 2025
summary: The second trailer, released with a full site refresh that introduced the supporting cast and Leonida's regions. Captured entirely in-game on PS5.

facts.text: Released May 6, 2025 together with new screenshots and character and location pages on the official site.
Rockstar said it was captured entirely in-game on a PlayStation 5, half gameplay and half cutscenes.
Reported to have reached 475 million views across platforms in 24 hours and won Best Game Trailer at the 2025 Golden Joystick Awards.
Music reported: The Pointer Sisters, Wang Chung, Zenglen and Tammy Wynette.

name: Trailer 1
subtitle: December 4, 2023
summary: The reveal: title, Lucia, Vice City and a 2025 window that would later slip twice. Rockstar posted it a day early after it leaked.

facts.text: Rockstar published the trailer on the evening of December 4, 2023 (US time), ahead of its planned December 5 debut, after it leaked online.
Set to Tom Petty's 'Love Is a Long Road'.
Reported to have drawn about 93 million views in its first day, a YouTube record at the time.

name: Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album
subtitle: 34 original songs · Nov 19, 2026
summary: A companion album of 34 new tracks made for the game, released by Atlantic Records on launch day. The first six songs are out now.

facts.text: Announced September 17, 2026; releases November 19, 2026 alongside the game, in partnership with Atlantic Records, with pre-saves open on streaming services.

First six songs released September 17: Yung Lean ft. Future & Metro Boomin ('That's It'), Travis Scott ('RHYNO'), CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso with PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Etienne de Crécy ('Sexy Magic'), Morgan Wallen ('Last Thing You Need'), Rauw Alejandro ('Macacoa 2000') and Keith Richards ('Bright Lights, Big City').
Sam Houser: music is fundamental to Rockstar and part of everything it does.

name: Official site and artwork
subtitle: rockstargames.com/VI
summary: Rockstar's hub for the game: trailers, character and location pages, edition details and downloadable artwork.

facts.text: Hosts all trailers, the Extended Look, character and region pages, edition information and a media/artwork download section.
